functional_mvp.description: Generic, headless, Rust-native hybrid DES/ABM ED simulation with editable scenario configuration, local CPU runner, deterministic outputs and useful basic summaries.
included: configurable arrivals/acuity, triage, assessment, diagnostics, treatment, disposition and boarding
configurable beds/treatment spaces, staffed capacity, staff skills/shifts, equipment and named zones
priority queues and reviewed staff-task interruption with no automatic patient eviction
seed/horizon controls and reproducible run manifest
CSV or JSON summaries with waits, length of stay, throughput, occupancy/utilization and terminal/unfinished counts
nominal and constrained/surge examples with controlled input-effect comparison
functional_mvp.acceptance: Delivery-contract E2 acceptance: clean bootstrap and documented example invocation; repeat seed reproduces canonical outputs; hand-computable route/queue cases agree; patient and resource conservation holds; malformed config fails clearly; the two example scenarios run without private data, renderer, network service or manual code edits; and a controlled comparison showing that the selected bed/staff input actually affects a known fixture.
contract_acceptance_markers: the two example scenarios run without private data
controlled comparison showing that the selected bed/staff input actually affects a known fixture

hardened_native_v1.description: MVP retained with documented Rust API/CLI, empirical calibration and validation, repeated experiments, recovery, real batch Arrow/Parquet paths, quality/security gates and clean-consumer release evidence.
hardened_native_v1.acceptance: Delivery-contract E4/G1 evidence: complete a clean consumer install; a fresh user can install the candidate, inspect/edit a documented scenario, run and compare two scenarios, export results and explain limitations without modifying Rust code or undocumented author assistance. Document a troubleshooting path, support matrix and input/schema migration policy; reproduce qualified artifacts and verify checksums/SBOM/provenance. No empirical accuracy claim follows from synthetic verification.
included: MVP required behavior plus a documented Rust API and CLI
Repeated experiments and uncertainty summaries with fixed-seed and worker-count equivalence
Real Arrow/Parquet and bounded empirical-data ingestion with independent reader/writer checks, units/timezones, provenance and exclusions
Bounded calibration, Macro/Micro, shadow and free-running validation with identifiability/confounding and held-out evidence
Queue/preemption conformance and compatibility with boundary traces and invariants
Cancellation, atomic outputs and checkpoint recovery with crash/resume and partial-output tests
Generic input coverage and usable example profiles with catalogue-to-consumer checks
Supported-platform quality/security/release evidence including risk-based fuzz/soak and licence/SBOM/provenance
Fresh-user workflow to install, inspect/edit a scenario, run and compare two scenarios, export results and explain limitations
Documented troubleshooting path, support matrix and input/schema migration policy
contract_acceptance_markers: support matrix and input/schema migration policy
No empirical accuracy claim follows from synthetic verification

post_v1.description: Separately gated visualization/spatial import, selected platform bindings, acceleration and parallel/distributed backends, only after native v1 and capability-specific evidence.
examples: CAD/vector floor-plan ingestion and spatial visualization
live streaming, ML policies, FMI co-simulation
Cairns adaptation and later clinical domains under their roadmap sequence

capabilities.capability: Fixed-tick time, checked arithmetic, and generational entity IDs; ED versioned handles and boundary policy remain incomplete.

evidence.claim: SimTime and SimDuration provide fixed u128 ticks with checked arithmetic, while EntityId encodes index/generation; broader ED handle/error policy is not shown.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Shared checked simulation time and entity identity needed for deterministic patient, staff and resource state.

capabilities.capability: Deterministic event scheduling and cancellation; checked Flow admission and actual scheduler snapshot/restore remain gaps.

evidence.claim: Scheduler orders queued events and supports cancel/step/run_until; schedule() accepts requests directly and no snapshot/restore API appears in this source.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Deterministic event execution for ED pathways; snapshot/recovery enhancements remain a v1 requirement.

capabilities.capability: Generational World and type-erased component stores/registry; unified runtime codecs and lifecycle invariants remain gaps.

evidence.claim: World supports spawn/despawn and sorted snapshots, and component storage is separate; this does not establish a unified DES/ABM runtime or context codecs.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Patient, staff, resource and pathway state for the runnable hybrid model.

capabilities.capability: Deterministic SplitMix64 streams derived from run seeds and entity handles; versioned purpose keys and distributions remain gaps.

evidence.claim: The crate derives repeatable entity streams and exposes u32/u64 draws; task-purpose keys and distribution sampling are not present in this API.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Seeded, repeatable ED arrivals and service-time draws; purpose-key hardening remains required before v1.

capabilities.capability: Legacy FIFO resource requests/releases and fixed-time trajectories; priority, preemption, lifecycle tokens, and Flow API are absent.

evidence.claim: Resource uses a VecDeque FIFO and request/release without ownership tokens; DESContext holds resources separately from World and schedules trajectories.

capabilities.stage_rationale: ED process timing, resource queues and admission/discharge transitions; priority/preemption conformance is required.

capabilities.capability: Scheduled behavior updates with World, component registry, and per-agent RNG; shared DES runtime and staff/transit policies remain gaps.

evidence.claim: ABMContext contains its own Scheduler, World, and ComponentRegistry; behavior receives an agent and RNG, with no DES Resource bridge in this API.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Minimal staff and patient agent behavior integrated with DES on shared time/state.

capabilities.capability: Versioned event-log schema and smoke serialization surface; real Arrow IPC/Parquet and bounded IO remain gaps.

evidence.claim: The crate defines an event-log schema and fingerprint; its manifest has only kairo-ecs-types as a dependency, so these lines do not evidence Arrow IPC/Parquet support.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Real Arrow/Parquet ingestion and output; MVP accepts CSV/JSON and does not require Arrow.

capabilities.capability: Scenario/seed manifest parsing and validation; full ED execution, recovery, cancellation, progress, and worker runs remain gaps.

evidence.claim: CLI scenario code loads manifests and validates schema, seeds, fixture presence, and run bounds; it does not establish a complete ED run service.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Documented scenario input, run, validation and CSV/JSON summary workflow.

capabilities.capability: Proposed reusable Rust calibration module; no crate exists in the pinned Kairos workspace.

evidence.claim: The parent readiness row labels this module proposed and assigns C0 ADR then C1-C6; it is a plan entry, not evidence of a Kairos implementation.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Reusable Rust-native empirical calibration/validation algorithms; no crate is implied to exist now.

capabilities.capability: Benchmark scenario definitions and smoke helpers exist; representative ED/resource/Arrow/calibration thresholds remain gaps.

evidence.claim: The source declares canonical scheduler/state/hybrid benchmark scenario names and smoke scales; it does not show the required representative ED workload thresholds.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Representative ED/resource/telemetry/calibration performance budgets and regression evidence.

capabilities.capability: Event trace snapshots and deltas exist; readable failure traces and replay integration remain gaps.

evidence.claim: EventTrace stores key-value snapshots and event deltas with deterministic sorting; these are not full ECS serialization or interactive time travel.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Diagnostic trace and replay integration for hardened recovery and auditability; no full interactive debugger promise.

capabilities.capability: Headless render-frame and snapshot facade; ED delta/backpressure/sampling and native renderer are unavailable.

evidence.claim: RenderFrame can be built from a WorldSnapshot; source constants state renderer dependencies are not configured, so no native renderer capability is inferred.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Snapshot/delta visualization, renderer and dashboard belong to later interactive delivery.

capabilities.capability: C ABI engine lifecycle, scheduling, stepping, and statistics bridge; ED Flow API exposure and ABI audit remain gaps.

evidence.claim: The FFI surface contains a Scheduler/World-backed engine state and C-compatible stats/status types; the observed API is a core bridge, not a new Flow API.

capabilities.delivery_gate: G2 if used by selected Wasm route
capabilities.stage_rationale: No native MVP/v1 FFI route is selected; if used later, ABI ownership and compatibility gates apply.

capabilities.capability: Limited FFI-backed WasmEngine wrapper with u64 tick scheduling; ED API, u128 mapping, worker lifecycle, and parity remain gaps.

evidence.claim: WasmEngine delegates to FFI and exposes u64 current-time/schedule values and stats; this does not establish the required ED surface or native parity.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Browser/Wasm delivery is outside native support and requires parity/lifecycle qualification.

capabilities.capability: UniFFI-ready wrapper over core FFI lifecycle; full ED expansion is deferred.

evidence.claim: The source describes a facade over the stable FFI and implements handle/schedule/step/stats/close; it does not implement a separate ED API.

capabilities.stage_rationale: No non-Rust binding API is required for native ED delivery.

capabilities.capability: Diplomat-ready wrapper over core FFI lifecycle; full ED expansion is deferred.

evidence.claim: DiplomatEngine reuses the FFI handle and exposes schedule, step, time, and stats; no independent ED API is evidenced.

capabilities.stage_rationale: No non-Rust binding API is required for native ED delivery.

capabilities.capability: C# P/Invoke re-export of the existing FFI surface; new C# ED work is deferred.

evidence.claim: The crate documents itself as re-exporting FFI functions for P/Invoke; it contains no separate C# ED implementation.

capabilities.stage_rationale: No C# binding API is required for native ED delivery.

capabilities.capability: CPU-side GPU facade and explicit unavailable backend contracts; real device dispatch, CPU oracle qualification, and device benchmarks remain gaps.

evidence.claim: GPU backend modules are feature-gated and the crate re-exports compute contracts; this source does not prove a GPU device is available or dispatch works on hardware.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Metal/device acceleration requires its own hardware correctness oracle and measured benefit.

capabilities.capability: Dependency-free browser WebGPU scaffold and reference dispatch API; browser device setup and parity remain gaps.

evidence.claim: The crate identifies itself as a scaffold and exports reference/browser dispatch surfaces; no browser device execution is established by this source.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Browser-device compute is deferred; it is distinct from any future visualization renderer.

capabilities.capability: Logical-process, event, null-message, and in-memory transport scaffolding; core Flow integration, GVT, and threaded evidence remain gaps.

evidence.claim: The crate defines partition and message contracts around SimTime; these declarations do not establish integrated parallel execution or GVT qualification.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Within-run parallel DES requires separate causality, ownership and equivalence evidence.

capabilities.capability: Dependency-free MPI protocol/rank contract scaffolding; MPI transport, launch, migration, and failure evidence remain gaps.

evidence.claim: The source labels its contract placeholder/dependency-free and defines rank/message envelope types; this is not an MPI runtime transport.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Distributed execution is outside the local CPU native release profile.

capabilities.capability: Dependency-free gRPC protocol/envelope contract scaffolding; service runtime, auth, recovery, and at-most-once migration remain gaps.

evidence.claim: The source calls this a placeholder protocol and defines envelope constructors; it does not provide tonic/prost service execution.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Networked/distributed execution is outside the local CPU native release profile.

capabilities.capability: Stream message/schema contracts exist; optional Kafka/NATS/Flight names do not establish live adapters or ingestion.

evidence.claim: The source defines stream names and message validation; the manifest declares feature names without runtime dependencies, so no live broker support is inferred.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Live ingestion/network sources are deferred; native v1 uses bounded batch input.

capabilities.capability: Tensor/model metadata and inference contracts exist; optional backend feature names do not establish learned policies or a runtime backend.

evidence.claim: The source provides validated Tensor and model metadata types; the manifest lists optional backend feature names without backend dependencies.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Learned policies/surrogates are not needed for the initial model and require separate validation.

capabilities.capability: Feature-gated FMI/AAS/digital-twin module surfaces exist; concrete co-simulation qualification is deferred.

evidence.claim: The crate gates import/export/AAS/digital-twin modules by feature; this surface alone does not establish a selected ED model integration.

capabilities.stage_rationale: Co-simulation is not needed for the initial ED; add only for a concrete future model need.
